a.lede: The two PlusAI trailers with Nvidia-partner markings were apparently left outside the startup's warehouse, making it a juicy target for criminals looking to make easy money on AI GPUs. However, they were deliberately left outside as the trailers only contained sand for simulating real-world truck loads.
a.title: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead

b.lede: They wanted the silicon. They got the sand.
b.title: Thieves Stole ‘Nvidia’ Trailers. They Got 20 Tons of Sand
